headline: The Statue of Liberty is dedicated
post_facts: A gift from the people of France
151 feet of copper in New York Harbor
It sparked NYC's first ticker-tape parade

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in eighteen eighty-six... America unveiled the Statue of Liberty.

scenes.label: New York Harbor
scenes.caption: Painting by Edward Moran, 1886
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] President Grover Cleveland dedicated this gift from France in New York Harbor.

scenes.label: of copper, from base to torch
scenes.text: [calmly] One hundred fifty-one feet of copper.

scenes.label: Paris, 1878
scenes.caption: Her head on display in Paris
scenes.text: [softly] Her sculptor, Bartholdi, waited inside her crown... and dropped the French flag from her face too soon.

scenes.title: NYC's first ticker-tape parade
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] The day also gave New York its first ticker-tape parade.

scenes.title: Have you seen her up close?
scenes.text: [gently] Have you ever seen her up close?
